response.justification: Technically the candidate exceeds every requirement: 15+ years of fullstack work, strong TypeScript/Node/React experience, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, and a track record of clean architecture and TDD advocacy. However, this is an entry-level individual contributor posting, and a Staff/Senior engineer with this depth is a significant seniority and compensation mismatch, with real risk of disengagement or short tenure. Location (Berlin) fits the on-site requirement, but only basic German could be limiting in a German energy-consulting/renovation domain with contractor-facing workflows. Worth a conversation only if the team is open to hiring above the posted level or the candidate has clearly signalled a deliberate step down.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node/React fullstack experience across many products
Strong cloud and infra skills: AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD
Berlin-based, matching the high on-site presence requirement
concerns: Substantially overqualified for an entry-level IC role
PostgreSQL/Nest.js not evidenced; database work skews MongoDB
Only basic German for a German construction/energy consulting domain

key_factors.factor: Core stack proficiency (TypeScript, React, Node, AWS)
